description.value: Yellow Deli is a chain of rustic, handcrafted delis founded in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1973 and operated by an intentional religious community. Locations are known for their distinctive décor of barn beams, macramé, leatherwork, and custom booth seating, often spread across multiple floors of converted spaces. The menu centres on sandwiches on fresh-baked bread, made-from-scratch soups, garden salads, and homemade desserts.
